text: The Association for Human Mathematics (AHM) protects mathematics as a human endeavor against the threat of artificial intelligence. We work to maintain the independence of the mathematical community from the encroachment of corporate interest. In light of the grave societal, environmental, and economic impacts of the AI industry and the threat of unfettered AI growth, we strive not to be complicit. Artificial intelligence tools pose a fundamental threat to scientific practice and mathematical understanding. Mathematical progress requires human expertise, cultivated through writing and careful thinking. The automated production and consumption of mathematics thus undermine the intellectual foundations of our field. The goals of the companies which are developing these technologies are not aligned with the mathematical community; this industry has chosen mathematics to advertise the capabilities of their products, regardless of the consequences to our discipline. Mathematicians thus have an obligation to take action. Mathematical institutions are especially vulnerable to disruption. The introduction of AI tools imperils undergraduate and graduate education. Journals are confronting an explosion in AI-coauthored submissions, and publication processes are in flux. Students are losing opportunities to gain the deep understanding expected of mathematicians. The AHM is organizing multiple working groups to provide policy proposals and tools to combat these problems. Both individual action and large-scale coordination are needed to ensure that mathematicians engage critically with AI companies and their products. We represent mathematicians who share these values, and we invite these mathematicians to join our work.
